WITH ExampleTable AS (
  SELECT 1 AS id, ['a', 'b', 'b', 'c'] AS f
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS id, ['a', 'c'] AS f
)

SELECT ML.BAG_OF_WORDS(f, 32, 1) OVER() AS results
FROM ExampleTable
ORDER BY id
shape: WITH ExampleTable AS (SELECT 1 AS id, ARRAY['a', 'b', 'b', 'c'] AS f UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, ARRAY['a', 'c'] AS f) SELECT ML.BAG_OF_WORDS(f, 32, 1) OVER () AS results FROM ExampleTable ORDER BY id;

WITH ExampleData AS (
  SELECT 1 AS id, ['a', 'b', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'd', 'd'] as f
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS id, ['a', 'c', 'c', 'd', 'd', 'd'] as f
)

SELECT id, ML.BAG_OF_WORDS(f, 2 ,2) OVER() as result
FROM ExampleData
ORDER BY id
